cross_verification.note_en: Solomon Islands Immigration Division (immigration.gov.sb, official government site) confirms a passport photo is required and states that 'Passport photo, finger prints and signature will be captured electronically before application form is submitted for assessment' — i.e. the photo is captured in-person at the Immigration Office rather than pre-supplied by the applicant against a printed spec sheet. No numeric size/background/composition specifications were found on the official site, its two linked application-form PDFs (Passport-Application-Form-1.pdf, Passport-Application-Form-2.pdf), or its Division Resources page. This is consistent with the limited scope of the country's official web presence; third-party photo-vendor sites cite figures like 3.5×4.5cm, but per policy these are not used as verified since no official confirmation was found.
